decision.summary: Full review, auto-escalated by review-diff.json. Four low findings, no medium or higher, so the run passes. The findings are: the section 4 sentence describing the CIB equity transfer as a movement 'between pockets of the one company' cites claim-054, whose own text attaches that phrase to the $150 million of Markets NII rather than to the equity transfer, and the transcript sentence that does state the equity transfer was never extracted; the section 8 peer bullet calls a 30%-versus-50% investment banking fee growth gap 'the clearest competitive signal in this evidence' without noting that the two rates sit on very different and partly unknown bases; section 9's statement that four peer sources were used omits a fifth same-day source that supplies the Goldman Sachs fee-growth leg of claim-073; and claim-032, the CEO's own 'getting close to as good as it gets' line, is extracted but cited nowhere, leaving the brief resting its normalisation premise on the narrower equities-specific caution in claims 030 and 031. Against that, the run is strong where it matters most. Every claim-### citation in the brief was opened and read, and each resolves to the right claim for its sentence; no adjacent-but-wrong citation was found. The exhaustive numeric semantic review over all value-bearing claims, including the single calculation block, found no operand, unit, sign, scope or period error, and the first-half versus full-year distinctions in the expense discussion are labelled correctly throughout. The transcript's '(sic) [Excluding]' correction is resolved the right way and is consistent with the SEC 10-Q facts. Temporal integrity holds: the only consensus source predates the event by five days, the two archived sources whose provider metadata looked clean but whose content contained post-event actuals were correctly excluded and that exclusion is disclosed, and the same-day nature of the peer results is stated rather than hidden. Both deterministic gates passed with zero issues across three attempts and the injection scan is clean.
